blocks.text: Introducing Bitzee Magicals, fantastical digital friends you can really touch and feel. Like Bitzee digital pets, Magicals respond to swipes, tilts, shakes and touch with sounds and reactions. Each character starts a baby and needs love and care to grow. The more you play, the more you’ll unlock. Feed them and play, rock them to sleep, clean up after them and give them love. Watch them grow from baby, to adult, to Super Bitzee. When a rare or legendary friend becomes a Super Bitzee, it splits between 1 of 2 possible Splitzee characters. Play games with your fully evolved Magicals and collect gems to add to your Treasure Chest to attract new characters. There’s more ways to play: cast spells with the Magic Wand and experience a fun transformation; earn Potions as you play games to change your friend’s colors. Collect all 20 characters and take your collection anywhere. Kids and adults will be mesmerized with Bitzee’s screen-free innovative twist on 90s toys & games. Must-have for birthday gifts or gifts for any occasion. Warning: produces flashes that may trigger epilepsy in sensitised individuals. Includes 3 AA batteries. Bring home a new way to experience Bitzee toys with Magicals.
